header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: whatever good you ask, may Allah Ta'ala grant you the like of that good too!” (he says to the one making Du'a). Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ used to say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَنَسٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: لَايُؤْمِنُ اَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّي يُحِبَّ لِاَخِيْهِ مَايُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب من الايمان ان يحب لاخيه ...رقم: ١٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “None of you can be a (perfect) Mu'min until he loves for his Muslim brother what he loves for himself.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ الْقُسَرِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِيْ اَبِيْ عَنْ جَدِّيْ ﵁ اَنَّهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَتُحِبُّ الْجَنَّةَ؟ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ! قَالَ: فَاَحِبَّ لِاَخِيْكَ مَاتُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِكَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: The Prophet ﷺ asked my grandfather, ““Do you desire Jannah?” (Do you wish to enter Jannah?)” He said, “Yes'. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Then love for your brother what you love for yourself!” Hazrat Khalid ibn Abdullah Qasri (RH) narrates this through his father, who narrates it from his grandfather.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنْ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: اِنَّ الدِّيْنَ النَّصِيْحَةُ، اِنَّ الدِّيْنَ النَّصِيْحَةُ، اِنَّ الدِّيْنَ النَّصِيْحَةُ، قَالُوْا: لِمَنْ يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: لِلّهِ، وَلِكِتَابِهِ، وَلِرَسُوْلِهِ، وَلِاَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي باب النصيحة للامام رقم:٤٢٠٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Indeed, the religion (Deen) is the name for acting with sincerity and faithfulness. Indeed, the religion (Deen) is the name for acting with sincerity and faithfulness
